scripts.site:typecheck: npm run site:typecheck:sync && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run site:typecheck:workers && npm run site:typecheck:eval
scripts.site:typecheck:sync: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro sync --root apps/quiet && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro sync --root apps/home
scripts.site:typecheck:workers: tsc --noEmit -p apps/quiet/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/live/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/home/worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.site:lint: eslint --config packages/config/eslint.config.js --max-warnings 0 apps packages workers && stylelint --config packages/config/stylelint.config.js --allow-empty-input "apps/**/*.{css,astro}" "packages/**/*.css"
scripts.site:test: npm run site:test:api && npm run site:test:quiet && npm run site:test:live && npm run site:test:rest
scripts.site:test:quiet: npm run test --workspace=apps/quiet && vitest run --config apps/quiet/worker/vitest.config.ts
scripts.site:test:live: npm run test --workspace=apps/live && vitest run --config apps/live/worker/vitest.config.ts && npm run site:test:eval
scripts.site:test:rest: npm run test --workspace=packages --workspace=apps/home --if-present && vitest run --config apps/home/worker/vitest.config.ts
